target.audience: anyone; two players sharing one device

mood.intent: The quiet of a game drawn on scrap paper between two people who happen to be nearby. Friendly, unhurried, low stakes; losing costs nothing but the pleasure of drawing the next grid.

anti.description: not an arena: no announcers, no glow, no dramatic stings, no victory fanfare
not a casino: no chance imagery, no jackpot celebration, nothing that implies luck was involved
not a children's toy: no wobbling mascots or candy gloss; the game is casual, not infantile
